item.title: IRGC official warns against foreign powers interfering in Hormuz Strait
item.description:
IRGC official warns against foreign powers interfering in Hormuz Strait

The commander-in-chief of Iran’s Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps (IRGC) said foreign powers have no right to interfere in the Strait of Hormuz.

"No extra-regional power has the right to threaten, maintain a hegemonic presence, or interfere in the Strait of Hormuz and the Persian Gulf," Ahmad Vahidi said.

Immigration agents raid home of Congresswoman Ilhan Omar, Trump calls her 'totally crooked'
item.description:
Immigration agents raid home of Congresswoman Ilhan Omar, Trump calls her 'totally crooked'

Federal agents from Homeland Security Investigations (HSI) on Monday carried out a raid on the Washington, DC, home of US Congresswoman Ilhan Omar, on suspicion of immigration fraud.

The pre-dawn raid on the Somali-born lawmaker's house was first reported by Fox News Digital, and confirmed to Fox News Business by US border czar Tom Homan, who said the Department of Justice (DOJ) was also involved.

Omar has been a frequent target of US President Donald Trump since his first term in office, when she was elected to the US House of Representatives in 2018.

Following the raid, Trump criticised Omar, but denied  any personal involvement in the investigation into the Minnesota congresswoman.

"I understand they're looking at her very carefully," he said, referring to federal authorities. "I've always found her to be totally crooked, personally, but that has nothing to do with me."

"I think she's a terrible person, but that's really up to the DOJ — I have nothing to do with it," he added.

Trump says US midterm elections will not impact approach to war on Iran
item.description:
Trump says US midterm elections will not impact approach to war on Iran

US President Donald Trump said that the upcoming midterm elections in the country will not affect his approach to the war on Iran.

When asked by a reporter if votes in early November could change his thinking, Trump responded by saying: "No, it has no impact."

Trump also said that "as soon as the war ends, which will be very soon with Iran, the [price of] oil will drop like a rock. And it’s going to end very soon."

item.title: Amid Gaza's ruins, Taekwondo athletes return to training after three years of genocide
item.description:
Amid Gaza's ruins, Taekwondo athletes return to training after three years of genocide

At Al-Bureij Camp in central Gaza, Taekwondo athletes are back on the mat after three years of genocide.

Coach Mahmoud Al-Kronz is training children amid the rubble with limited resources, keeping sport alive and giving his students a break from the weight of war. 

Before October 2023, his team was preparing to compete at the Fujairah championship in the UAE. Repeated displacement and famine brought training to a halt.

item.title: Iran’s IRGC says 3rd ‘offending’ supertanker hit in Strait of Hormuz in 2 days
item.description: Iran’s Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps (IRGC) navy said Monday that a third supertanker it described as “offending” was struck in the Strait of Hormuz in two days and caught fire, Anadolu reports. In a statement issued by its public relations office, the navy said the tanker was hit Monday morning after switching off its navigation system and ignoring warnings. It alleged that the vessel, like those previously hit, had attempted to leave the strait and disrupt order and security in the waterway. The statement did not identify the tanker, its flag or operator, or specify how it was struck. item.title: UN pledges technical support for Palestinian elections amid vote delay
item.description: The UN reaffirmed its commitment Monday to assisting Palestinian electoral authorities following the postponement of legislative elections originally planned for late November, Anadolu reports. “We will continue to support the Palestinian Central Election Commission to ensure that technical preparations are in place when the actual elections take place,” Stephane Dujarric, spokesperson for UN Secretary-General Antonio Guterres, told reporters. The remarks followed a decree issued Saturday by Palestinian President Mahmoud Abbas rescheduling legislative elections for Sept. 11, 2027. The move formally rescinded an earlier order that had scheduled parliamentary elections for Nov. 28, 2026, which would have marked the first parliamentary vote in 20 years. item.title: Israeli army enters Syria’s Quneitra countryside, blocks construction work
item.description: Israeli army forces entered Syria’s southwestern Quneitra countryside on Monday and blocked construction work in the area, according to state-run Alikhbariah TV. The broadcaster said six Israeli military vehicles advanced south of the town of Al-Rafid in Quneitra province. Israeli forces also prevented local residents from digging foundations for construction in the area, it added. READ: UN urges Israel to end harassment, intimidation, detention of civilians in Syria In a separate incident, Alikhbariah reported that Israeli forces blew up an abandoned military barracks at Tal Harboun near the town of Beit Jinn in the western Damascus countryside. item.title: Sudan’s Burhan orders inquiry after reported killing of 72 miners near Egyptian border
item.description: Sudan’s Transitional Sovereignty Council Chairman Abdel Fattah al-Burhan on Monday ordered a fact-finding investigation into the reported killing of miners near the Egyptian border on Saturday, Anadolu reports. The council said in a statement that the committee would include representatives of the Public Prosecution and relevant judicial and security bodies. It will investigate the circumstances surrounding the incident and submit a report on its findings. No deadline was announced. “Protecting the lives of Sudanese citizens and safeguarding their safety and dignity is a fundamental responsibility of the state,” Burhan said.
